checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: ~10s vertical video with intelligible English voice-over
must.why: 10s vertical confirmed and audio present, but speech intelligibility can't be judged.

must.item: Narration explains sound reflects off a surface and returns
Visuals show sound traveling from source to surface and back
must.why: Rainbow rings expand around the child and stay centered on him; no clear travel to the wall and a visible bounce back. Wall never clearly hit.
Cannot hear the words; the script as written is simple but completion is unknown.

must.item: Visual journey and spoken explanation agree
must.why: Visuals only loosely show a ring around the child; the agreement with speech cannot be verified.

faults.what: Sound waves appear as a static rainbow ring around the child rather than clearly traveling to the rock wall and bouncing back; the echo concept is not conveyed visually.
No visible ball-bounce as described in the narration.
Child's pose and framing change little; the ring overlaps the body awkwardly, with some glow artefacts.

summary: A polished 3D cartoon of a child in a canyon with rainbow sound rings, but the rings stay around the child instead of visibly traveling to the wall and back, so the echo isn't clearly shown, and the voice-over couldn't be checked.
